_comment: Hand-authored. Bank 7: NMI, PPU queue, palettes, score bonus ($DC75-$DFB0). The generators subtract these.

regions.name: NMI, PPU QUEUE, PALETTES AND THE SCORE BONUS (bank 7 `$DC75-$DFAE`): NMI: save the registers (`$DC75`, the NMI vector)
regions.description: A, X, Y pushed.

regions.name: NMI, PPU QUEUE, PALETTES AND THE SCORE BONUS (bank 7 `$DC75-$DFAE`): NMI: rendering off
regions.description: PPUMASK := `$FE` AND `$E7` (background and sprites off for the vblank work).

regions.name: NMI, PPU QUEUE, PALETTES AND THE SCORE BONUS (bank 7 `$DC75-$DFAE`): NMI: the frame counter
regions.description: `INC $2B`: the frame counter every wait (`$DA9A`, `$FFD1`) spins on.

regions.name: NMI, PPU QUEUE, PALETTES AND THE SCORE BONUS (bank 7 `$DC75-$DFAE`): NMI: the PPU status
regions.description: PPUSTATUS into `$26` (bit 5 = sprite overflow, read by the sprite allocator).

regions.name: NMI, PPU QUEUE, PALETTES AND THE SCORE BONUS (bank 7 `$DC75-$DFAE`): NMI: OAM DMA
regions.description: OAMADDR := 0 and a DMA from `$0200`.

regions.name: NMI, PPU QUEUE, PALETTES AND THE SCORE BONUS (bank 7 `$DC75-$DFAE`): NMI: APU channels
regions.description: PPUSTATUS read again; `$4015` := `$1F` (all five channels enabled, the DMC included).

regions.name: NMI, PPU QUEUE, PALETTES AND THE SCORE BONUS (bank 7 `$DC75-$DFAE`): NMI: the staged row and the queue
regions.description: `JSR $DD54`.

regions.name: NMI, PPU QUEUE, PALETTES AND THE SCORE BONUS (bank 7 `$DC75-$DFAE`): NMI: the palettes
regions.description: `JSR $DEC9`.

regions.name: NMI, PPU QUEUE, PALETTES AND THE SCORE BONUS (bank 7 `$DC75-$DFAE`): NMI: the split marker
regions.description: If `$30` bit 4 is set and sprite 0's y is not `$F8`: **the tile `$FE` is written at column 0 of the nametable row that line (sprite 0 y + 1 + the scroll `$FC`, modulo 240) falls in (`$0800`-based address, y AND `$F8` x 4)** - the solid tile the sprite-0 hit needs, moved with the scroll. (`$30` bit 4 is therefore 'the scroll moves the split'.)

regions.name: NMI, PPU QUEUE, PALETTES AND THE SCORE BONUS (bank 7 `$DC75-$DFAE`): NMI: the scroll
regions.description: `JSR $D68B`.

regions.name: NMI, PPU QUEUE, PALETTES AND THE SCORE BONUS (bank 7 `$DC75-$DFAE`): NMI: rendering back on
regions.description: `JSR $DD48`: PPUMASK := (`$FE` AND `$E7`) OR `$A3`.

regions.name: NMI, PPU QUEUE, PALETTES AND THE SCORE BONUS (bank 7 `$DC75-$DFAE`): NMI: the sound
regions.description: The live bank saved; bank 0 (`$D714`); `JSR $8009` (the sound tick `$917C`); the bank restored (`$D705`).

regions.name: NMI, PPU QUEUE, PALETTES AND THE SCORE BONUS (bank 7 `$DC75-$DFAE`): NMI: stir the random state
regions.description: `TSX`: `$2A` := ROL(stack pointer + `$2A` + carry): the NMI's stack depth varies, so the random state is stirred by it.

regions.name: NMI, PPU QUEUE, PALETTES AND THE SCORE BONUS (bank 7 `$DC75-$DFAE`): NMI: return
regions.description: Y, X, A pulled; `RTI`.

regions.name: NMI, PPU QUEUE, PALETTES AND THE SCORE BONUS (bank 7 `$DC75-$DFAE`): the DMC IRQ (the IRQ vector)
regions.description: `$4015` := `$0F` (acknowledge). **If sprite 0 is already hit when the IRQ arrives (PPUSTATUS bit 6), it is late: the DMC rate index `$05` is incremented (kept at `$89` at most) and the new rate written to DMC_FREQ, without a split.** Otherwise it spins on PPUSTATUS until the hit (`$DD21` makes the split, then the rate `$05` is written) or until the frame counter `$2B` changes (it gives up). The rate thus converges so that the IRQ arrives just before the split line.

regions.name: NMI, PPU QUEUE, PALETTES AND THE SCORE BONUS (bank 7 `$DC75-$DFAE`): the split (`$DD21`)
regions.description: PPUADDR := `$2700` (nametable 1 row 24); PPUCTRL := (`$FF` AND `$FC`) OR 1 (nametable 1); PPUMASK sprites off; PPUSCROLL := 0, 0: **everything below the split is the HUD.**

regions.name: NMI, PPU QUEUE, PALETTES AND THE SCORE BONUS (bank 7 `$DC75-$DFAE`): PPUMASK from the shadow (`$DD48`)
regions.description: `$FE` AND `$E7` OR `$A3` into PPUMASK.

regions.name: NMI, PPU QUEUE, PALETTES AND THE SCORE BONUS (bank 7 `$DC75-$DFAE`): the PPU work: the scroll bits (`$DD54`)
regions.description: `$A0` bit 7 set: `JSR $D507` (commit the scroll). **PPUCTRL's low two bits := `$A2`.**

regions.name: NMI, PPU QUEUE, PALETTES AND THE SCORE BONUS (bank 7 `$DC75-$DFAE`): the staged row?
regions.description: `$A5` zero skips to the queue (`$DE0C`).

regions.name: NMI, PPU QUEUE, PALETTES AND THE SCORE BONUS (bank 7 `$DC75-$DFAE`): a staged row: which?
regions.description: `$A5` odd (1 or 3) is a row with its attribute bytes; `$A5` becomes 2 (from 1) or 0 (from 3); `$A5` = 2 is the second tile row.

regions.name: NMI, PPU QUEUE, PALETTES AND THE SCORE BONUS (bank 7 `$DC75-$DFAE`): the attribute bytes' address
regions.description: PPUADDR := (`$AD` OR 3 = the attribute table page) : `$AA`.

regions.name: NMI, PPU QUEUE, PALETTES AND THE SCORE BONUS (bank 7 `$DC75-$DFAE`): the attribute bytes
regions.description: Y := 0 and the eight bytes `$04E8-$04EF` to PPUDATA.

regions.name: NMI, PPU QUEUE, PALETTES AND THE SCORE BONUS (bank 7 `$DC75-$DFAE`): the attribute bytes, written
regions.description: Eight `LDA $04E8+k / STA PPUDATA`.

regions.name: NMI, PPU QUEUE, PALETTES AND THE SCORE BONUS (bank 7 `$DC75-$DFAE`): the first tile row's address
regions.description: PPUADDR := `$AD:$AC`; Y := 0 and on to the tile loop.

regions.name: NMI, PPU QUEUE, PALETTES AND THE SCORE BONUS (bank 7 `$DC75-$DFAE`): the second tile row
regions.description: `$A5` := 0; PPUADDR := `$AD`:(`$AC` OR `$20`) (the row below); Y := `$20`.

regions.name: NMI, PPU QUEUE, PALETTES AND THE SCORE BONUS (bank 7 `$DC75-$DFAE`): the tile loop
regions.description: **32 bytes of the staging buffer `$0130+Y` to PPUDATA, eight at a time, until Y AND `$1F` = 0:** `$0130-$014F` is the top row, `$0150-$016F` the bottom.

regions.name: NMI, PPU QUEUE, PALETTES AND THE SCORE BONUS (bank 7 `$DC75-$DFAE`): the queue
regions.description: `$20` (the number of items) zero returns. Otherwise `$21` := 0 (the length is reset before the items are sent) and X := 0.

regions.name: NMI, PPU QUEUE, PALETTES AND THE SCORE BONUS (bank 7 `$DC75-$DFAE`): an item: its type
regions.description: The first byte: **under `$80` a run with increment 1 (`$DEA9`)**; `$80-$BF` a run with increment 32 (count AND `$7F`); `$C0-$FF` the 9-byte cell item.

regions.name: NMI, PPU QUEUE, PALETTES AND THE SCORE BONUS (bank 7 `$DC75-$DFAE`): a cell item: the page
regions.description: Bit 6 set: PPU page := `$20` OR (the byte AND `$0F`); the attribute page = that OR 3.

regions.name: NMI, PPU QUEUE, PALETTES AND THE SCORE BONUS (bank 7 `$DC75-$DFAE`): a cell item: the attribute address
regions.description: X saved in `$23`; Y := the item's byte 5 (the attribute address low byte); PPUADDR set up.

regions.name: NMI, PPU QUEUE, PALETTES AND THE SCORE BONUS (bank 7 `$DC75-$DFAE`): a cell item: read the attribute byte
regions.description: **Read PPUDATA twice and again until two consecutive reads agree** (the DMC corrupts PPU reads).

regions.name: NMI, PPU QUEUE, PALETTES AND THE SCORE BONUS (bank 7 `$DC75-$DFAE`): a cell item: change it
regions.description: Value := (value AND the item's byte 8) OR the item's byte 7; written back.

regions.name: NMI, PPU QUEUE, PALETTES AND THE SCORE BONUS (bank 7 `$DC75-$DFAE`): a cell item: the tiles
regions.description: PPUADDR := the page : the item's low byte; a first tile byte of `$FF` means 'attribute only'; otherwise two tiles, then PPUADDR + `$20` and two more: a 2 x 2 cell.

regions.name: NMI, PPU QUEUE, PALETTES AND THE SCORE BONUS (bank 7 `$DC75-$DFAE`): next item
regions.description: X += 8 (9 bytes with the type byte), `DEC $20`, again.

regions.name: NMI, PPU QUEUE, PALETTES AND THE SCORE BONUS (bank 7 `$DC75-$DFAE`): queue done
regions.description: `RTS`.

regions.name: NMI, PPU QUEUE, PALETTES AND THE SCORE BONUS (bank 7 `$DC75-$DFAE`): a stride-32 run
regions.description: PPUCTRL |= 4 (increment 32) and on into the run.

regions.name: NMI, PPU QUEUE, PALETTES AND THE SCORE BONUS (bank 7 `$DC75-$DFAE`): a run (`$DEA9`)
regions.description: PPUADDR := the item's high and low bytes; Y = the count bytes to PPUDATA (a count of 0 sends 256); then PPUCTRL is restored from `$FF` and the next item.

regions.name: NMI, PPU QUEUE, PALETTES AND THE SCORE BONUS (bank 7 `$DC75-$DFAE`): the palettes: which? (`$DEC9`)
regions.description: `$017F`: 0 nothing; 1 the background palettes; 2 the sprite palettes; 3 both.

regions.name: NMI, PPU QUEUE, PALETTES AND THE SCORE BONUS (bank 7 `$DC75-$DFAE`): the palettes: background (`$DED2`)
regions.description: PPUADDR := `$3F00`; four palettes (`CMP #3` both, else on).

regions.name: NMI, PPU QUEUE, PALETTES AND THE SCORE BONUS (bank 7 `$DC75-$DFAE`): the palettes: sprites
regions.description: PPUADDR := `$3F10`, Y := `$0C` (the sprite palettes start at `$018D`).

regions.name: NMI, PPU QUEUE, PALETTES AND THE SCORE BONUS (bank 7 `$DC75-$DFAE`): the palettes: two
NMI, PPU QUEUE, PALETTES AND THE SCORE BONUS (bank 7 `$DC75-$DFAE`): the palettes: write
regions.description: Per palette: the backdrop `$0180` then three colours from `$0181+Y` (Y steps by 6 for two palettes a pass); **every palette's colour 0 is the one backdrop `$0180`.**

regions.name: NMI, PPU QUEUE, PALETTES AND THE SCORE BONUS (bank 7 `$DC75-$DFAE`): the palettes: finish
regions.description: PPUADDR := `$3F00` and then 0 twice (the palette address glitch is avoided) and `$017F` := 0.

regions.name: NMI, PPU QUEUE, PALETTES AND THE SCORE BONUS (bank 7 `$DC75-$DFAE`): return
regions.description: `RTS`.

regions.name: NMI, PPU QUEUE, PALETTES AND THE SCORE BONUS (bank 7 `$DC75-$DFAE`): score bonus (`$DF3D`, after every score add)
regions.description: The threshold `$017C` has bit 7 set (overflow): return. The score's top three digits `$0170-$0172` are compared with the threshold `$017C-$017E` (digit by digit, `SBC`); below it: return.

regions.name: NMI, PPU QUEUE, PALETTES AND THE SCORE BONUS (bank 7 `$DC75-$DFAE`): score bonus: the next threshold
NMI, PPU QUEUE, PALETTES AND THE SCORE BONUS (bank 7 `$DC75-$DFAE`): score bonus: the award
regions.description: Unless `$30` bit 2 (quiet) is set, `JSR $DF8C`; then back to `$DF3D` (a big jump can give several).

regions.name: NMI, PPU QUEUE, PALETTES AND THE SCORE BONUS (bank 7 `$DC75-$DFAE`): score bonus: the award (`$DF8C`, slot `$C033`)
regions.description: Song `$31`; the chips `$4C/$4D` := CHIP MAX `$4E/$4F`; `LDA #0 / JSR $D76F` with `06 E6 FC` (a far call into `$FCE7` with bank 6: add 0 chips - clamps, redraws and re-derives the gun tier);

regions.name: NMI, PPU QUEUE, PALETTES AND THE SCORE BONUS (bank 7 `$DC75-$DFAE`): score bonus: max life + 8
regions.description: `$47` += 8 (capped `$FF`), `$48` := `$47`, `JMP $E424` (redraw the life meter's end).
